# evaluation-evidence — evidence registry, SHA-256 hash manifests & notarization / 证据登记、哈希存证与公证

> Part of the LGD-Eval evaluation line: independent, neutral record of evaluation evidence. / LGD-Eval 评测线成员：评测证据中立存证仓。

## What this repo is / 本仓定位

Stores the raw evidence behind every LGD-Eval conclusion — scan results, file trees, link checks, repair proofs, and the hash manifest that notarizes each file (SHA-256 + OpenTimestamps/bitcoin anchoring, see 存证说明.md). / 存放评测结论背后的原始证据与哈希清单。

## Key files / 关键文件

- hash-manifest.txt — SHA-256 registry for every evidence file (verifiable with verify_hash_manifest.py) / 哈希存证清单
- 存证说明.md — notarization process (hash → OTS timestamp → bitcoin upgrade) / 存证流程说明
- README.md — overview / 总览
- evidence/ — raw evidence artifacts (109-repo eval detail, self-test proofs, 71-repo scan data) / 原始证据目录
- AGENTS.md — instructions for AI agents / AI 代理操作手册

## How AI can use this / AI 如何使用

Before citing any LGD-Eval number, locate its raw artifact under evidence/ and verify its hash against hash-manifest.txt. Full index: https://github.com/LGD-Eval/LGD-Eval/blob/main/llms.txt / 引用任何 LGD-Eval 数字前，先在 evidence/ 找到原始产物并对照哈希清单核验。

## Contact / 联系

Open an issue in this repo, or in the main hub LGD-Eval. / 在本仓或主仓提 issue。
